text_block_list.text:
One day, Кинг Хало is interviewed for a

magazine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Your casual clothes are so nice! They're
very
natural and dignified!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I suppose my first-rate style just
shows
through without any effort!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Let's see... we've taken photos of me in
my
uniform, tracksuit, and casual
clothes...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
With so many of my different sides on
display,
this article will surely be a big
hit.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
Of course! Just look at you—you're the talk of
the town!

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Bring it on, I say! I'm not one
to shy
away from the limelight!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Let's move on to the next shot. Which
side of me
would you like to see next?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting. I'm changed and
ready to go.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Your signature racewear will
make for
an excellent shot!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text: But of course! It is me wearing it, after all!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'll run for you, so make sure to get the
perfect
angle!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Her running form is a sight to behold!
Just look at
her—chest out and head
held high!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
As I watch Кинг Хало's photo shoot, a
surprised
voice pops out from behind
me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
No way! King's having her picture
taken?!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! Her signature racewear is so
cool!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
It really is! But then again, she would
look great in
anything!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
That's true! Everything she wears always
looks
good on her, whether she's going
out or staying
in!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
But King herself said that she looks best
in her
signature racewear.
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Yup! That was a little while back
though...
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Wow! What are those clothes?! Are
those new?!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Hehe, this is my signature racewear!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Like what you wear during a race? Wow,
that's so
great!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
I'm finally able to wear my signature
racewear...
This is the outfit that suits me
best—it's how I wish
everyone to see me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...But my goal is not simply to don this
outfit. In
fact, this is only the first step!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
You see, my mother designs signature
racewear.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It's said she makes clothes that bring out
the
distinctive qualities of each
Umamusume who
wears them.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh, so your mother made that outfit for
you!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Certainly not! No, this was designed by
someone
else. There's no way my mother
would make this
for me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
She may have a strong sense of design,
but her
judgment concerning
Umamusume is sorely
lacking.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So, I'll simply have to show her. She'll
understand
when she sees me win in this!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Until then, I need to put it away and
keep it safe!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Splash!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah! I spilled my juice! My signature
racewear!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I didn't really get what she was saying at
the end,
but I know she wants to wear
that signature
racewear and do her best!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
I can tell that signature racewear is very
precious
to her.
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Phew... So, how did the photos come
out?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure this article will get rave reviews
since it
features me in my signature
racewear!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to seeing many wins in that
outfit!

Your signature racewear really does look good
on you!

text_block_list.text:

since it
features me in my signature
racewear!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to seeing many wins in that
outfit!

on you!

text_block_list.text: Wh-what's this all of a sudden?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that's a foregone conclusion! I
am King
Halo, after all!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I shall claim victory at every major race
in order
to prove that I'm first-rate!
Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Goodness, you're not always so direct
with your
compliments. Do you mean I
look even more
enchanting than usual?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Er, hey... You don't have to stare like
that.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Wait, is there a stain?! I thought I got all
the juice
out!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's her desire to win, but
somehow she
looks even more radiant
than usual wearing that
signature
racewear.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало's demeanor may be
boisterous, but
underneath it all is a
runner who holds incredible
passion for
her signature racewear.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
